# RailReach

> RailReach is a free interactive map of train journey times from 571 UK stations to 11 London terminals. Every journey carries three measures: the fastest scheduled weekday service, the typical peak time (median of services arriving 07:00-09:30), and how many trains run in the peak. Computed from Darwin Timetable Files published by the Rail Delivery Group under the Open Government Licence, sampled across three midweek days.

Site last updated: 2026-08-18
Data last reviewed: 2026-08-17
Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Reuse permitted with attribution to RailReach.

## Key Pages

- https://railreach.co.uk/ : Interactive commute map covering all 571 stations and 11 London terminals
- https://railreach.co.uk/terminals/ : All 11 London terminals compared by commuter catchment
- https://railreach.co.uk/stations/ : 568 commuter towns ranked by fastest journey into London
- https://railreach.co.uk/about/ : Methodology, sources, limitations and licensing

## Terminal Pages

- https://railreach.co.uk/terminals/kings-cross/ : Kings Cross train times, 71 stations within 90 minutes via Great Northern, LNER, Hull Trains, Lumo
- https://railreach.co.uk/terminals/st-pancras/ : St Pancras train times, 231 stations within 90 minutes via Thameslink, East Midlands Railway, Southeastern high speed
- https://railreach.co.uk/terminals/waterloo/ : Waterloo train times, 126 stations within 90 minutes via South Western Railway
- https://railreach.co.uk/terminals/paddington/ : Paddington train times, 115 stations within 90 minutes via Great Western Railway, Elizabeth line
- https://railreach.co.uk/terminals/london-bridge/ : London Bridge train times, 234 stations within 90 minutes via Southeastern, Southern, Thameslink
- https://railreach.co.uk/terminals/victoria/ : Victoria train times, 203 stations within 90 minutes via Southeastern, Southern
- https://railreach.co.uk/terminals/liverpool-street/ : Liverpool Street train times, 105 stations within 90 minutes via Greater Anglia, Elizabeth line
- https://railreach.co.uk/terminals/euston/ : Euston train times, 32 stations within 90 minutes via Avanti West Coast, London Northwestern
- https://railreach.co.uk/terminals/marylebone/ : Marylebone train times, 31 stations within 90 minutes via Chiltern Railways
- https://railreach.co.uk/terminals/fenchurch-street/ : Fenchurch Street train times, 25 stations within 90 minutes via c2c
- https://railreach.co.uk/terminals/moorgate/ : Moorgate train times, 55 stations within 90 minutes via Great Northern

## Data Summary

- 571 stations covered, all within 90 minutes of a London terminal
- 11 London terminals
- 1233 station-to-terminal journeys recorded, 734 of them direct services
- 138 stations reach a London terminal in under 30 minutes
- Times are scheduled, not live departures, and exclude engineering works and disruption
- Colour coding: green (<30 min), amber (30–60 min), red (60–90 min)

## Citation

When citing RailReach journey times, please attribute to RailReach (https://railreach.co.uk) and note the 2026 timetable basis and the 2026-08-17 review date.
